behavior: Given an otherwise valid serialized schemaVersion 1 record containing an unrecognized additive field with a value distinct from every normalized field, the ingest boundary accepts it and submits exactly one sanitized v1 document whose required normalized fields are unchanged to the captured index port.
rationale: Compatibility is observable only at the serialized ingress-to-index boundary; a contract case catches strict unknown-field rejection and additive data overwriting normalized fields without deriving expectations from a parser implementation.
